core_obligations: Choose a presentation square with U, V schemes, etale vertical arrows and U -> X surjective (proof lines 6012-6019).
Translate flatness of f into flatness of h and flatness of f at x into flatness of h at any point u over x (proof lines 6020-6024).
Apply the corresponding statement for morphisms of schemes to conclude (proof lines 6025-6027).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S is flat if and only if it is flat at all points of |X| (source lines 6005-6009). The proof is a definition chase through a presentation: choose a square with U, V schemes, etale vertical arrows and U -> X surjective; flatness of f is by definition equivalent to flatness of the induced scheme morphism h : U -> V, and flatness of f at x is by definition equivalent to flatness of h at some (equivalently any) u mapping to x; the statement then follows from the corresponding fact for morphisms of schemes, which is part of the definition of flatness for schemes.
